  425: ## IV. Baryogenesis Implications: Block-Diagonal Protection Now L_max-Invariant
  426: 
  427: ### IV.a The Sector Isolation is Permanent at All L_max
  428: 
  429: W5-D establishes that the (0,0) sector of D_K is **block-diagonal from all non-trivial sectors at every L_max tested**, with the block separation arising from the Clifford/Kosmann singlet projection being completely independent of the other SU(3) irreps:
  430: - At L_max = 3: 1232 eigenvalues across 10 sectors, (0,0) block is 16-dimensional
  431: - At L_max = 5: ~5200 eigenvalues across 21 sectors, (0,0) block is still 16-dimensional
  432: - At L_max = 7: 20,064 eigenvalues across 36 sectors, (0,0) block is still 16-dimensional
  433: 
  434: **The (0,0) sector is where the phonon-exflation physics lives**: the BCS condensate is SU(3)-singlet by the S71 W1-F theorem (Weyl-27 rep decomposition gives <1|27> = 0 at ALL orders at the leading level, marginal 1.16e-3 at two-loop), the Pfaffian is defined on this 16-dim spinor space, the Leggett DM is protected here (S73A W1-B), and the three-phonon process lives here (W3-E, W5-D).
  435: 
  436: **L_max-invariance of the block isolation means**: adding higher-sector physics cannot leak matter-antimatter asymmetry INTO the (0,0) sector from the outside. The high-L_max modes (p + q > 3 irreps like (0,4), (2,2), etc.) live in disconnected BCS ladders that do not couple to the (0,0) ladder at any order in perturbation theory.
